topics.title: What summarising is and how it differs from note-making

concepts.learning_objective: Distinguish a summary from notes in purpose, length and form.
Recall the steps of summarising and how points are expanded and linked.

topics.title: Precise expression: one word for many

concepts.learning_objective: Replace a long phrase with a single precise word, as in 'precocious' or 'versatile'.
Apply the guideline that a summary is usually about one-third of the original.
Identify apposition, present participles and a postponed main verb as devices that shorten a summary.
Understand the main facts and causes described in 'Green Sahara'.
Evaluate which details of a passage belong in its summary.
